gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-supreme: Otherworldly and wide-spaced, Alien Encounters sets its letters apart. Supreme backs it with a crisp, heavy-looking plain sans, and the heading earns its keep when it is big and short.
gen-eater-general-sans: Dark, jagged menace with room to breathe. General Sans takes over below with a smooth, steady stroke, and you can nudge its size up since its tall lowercase fills the line.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-fs-rowan: Bruno Ace SC looks bent from a single wire, its letters strung out like beads on a thread. It is made to announce; Rowan, the serif, is made to settle in and be read.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-fs-rowan: Commanding and distinctive, Cherry Swash flings a wide-open horseshoe c across the top. Rowan follows in its classic serif manner, with generous curves and thin strokes at half the weight of thick ones, which keeps long paragraphs friendly.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-rowan: Bold, with parallel stroke edges running through every curve, Comic Relief grabs attention fast. Rowan, a classic serif, does the quieter work of a literary, friendly voice with mild thick-thin shifts.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-rowan: Rowan is literary and friendly, with generous openings in every curve. Over many lines its text serif strokes taper like a sharpened carpenter's pencil, a gentle contrast to Gabarito's fixed-pen heading.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-rowan: Ruler-straight strokes and a gaping e give Happy Monkey a cheeky, bold face. Rowan follows in a friendly serif whose thin strokes never turn spindly, and the heading earns its keep when big and short.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-paquito: Paquito reads low and confident, with caps barely rising above the lowercase. Oxanium's tall, monoline heading sits over that classic serif like a technical sketch above handwriting, so the two feel clearly different.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-paquito: Scattered, shouting lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Paprika and Paquito differ sharply, a commanding heading against a confident, approachable text serif, and that gap is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-rowan: Phudu draws a plain ballpoint line with generous openings on every curve. Rowan, a classic serif with a faint crayon-like rhythm, adds warmth, and that shift from bold to literary is the pair's strongest quality.
